tagline.en: Genmo's Mochi-1 — an Apache-2.0 open text-to-video model with strong motion quality.
tagline.zh: Genmo 的 Mochi-1——Apache-2.0 开源文生视频模型,运动质量出色。

en: Mochi-1 is Genmo's open text-to-video model, released as a preview under Apache-2.0. You give it a text prompt and it generates a short video clip.
Mochi-1 is a diffusion-based video generator known for its motion fidelity and prompt adherence, released as fully open weights so you can run it locally rather than through a hosted API.
In WorldFoundry you run Mochi-1 through the shared pipeline — give it a prompt, set the seed and sampling controls, and it writes out a video from the official preview checkpoint.
zh: Mochi-1 是 Genmo 开源的文生视频模型,以预览版形式在 Apache-2.0 许可下发布。你给它一段文字提示,它便生成一段短视频。
Mochi-1 是基于扩散的视频生成模型,以运动保真度和对提示词的贴合度著称,并以完全开放的权重发布,因此你可以在本地运行,而不必通过托管 API。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你通过统一 pipeline 运行 Mochi-1——给它提示词,设置 seed 与采样控制,它就会基于官方预览版 checkpoint 输出一段视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Mochi-1 when you want an openly-licensed text-to-video model with strong motion, and prefer running open weights locally over a hosted service.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个开放许可、运动表现出色的文生视频模型,并倾向在本地运行开放权重而非托管服务时,可以选择 Mochi-1。

notFor.en: It's a preview release focused on text-to-video, not image-to-video. The checkpoint is large and downloaded separately, so plan for the download and GPU memory.
notFor.zh: 它是聚焦文生视频的预览版本,而非图生视频。Checkpoint 较大且需单独下载,请预留下载时间与显存。

en: Text-to-video with strong motion quality and prompt adherence
Runs locally through WorldFoundry's shared pipeline
zh: 文生视频,运动质量与提示词贴合度出色
通过 WorldFoundry 统一 pipeline 在本地运行
